properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: Ed25519 signatures ship in the build via tweetnacl (dependency chain of eth-crypto/eth-lightwallet); Shor-vulnerable. No application call site found in this repo, but the algorithm is present in the shipped bundle.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: ECDSA (secp256k1 via elliptic/ethereumjs) ships in the build; application call sites are hardhat.config.js BIP32 HD derivation (reported separately) and ethers.js wallet creation.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: ECDH key agreement ships via tweetnacl (X25519-based box) in the build; Shor-vulnerable. No application call site found in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: X25519 ships via tweetnacl in the build; Shor-vulnerable key agreement. No application call site found in this repo.

components.name: Node.js tls sessions on default settings (Node.js 16)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: AES ships via node-forge (@nomicfoundation/hardhat-toolbox chain). Symmetric AE — Grover-only exposure. No application call site found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: PBKDF2 ships in the build via the pbkdf2/bip39 chain; the real application use site is hardhat.config.js:410 (bip39.mnemonicToSeed), reported separately as a new finding.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: SHA-256 ships via sha.js/@noble/hashes; used at runtime by the bip39 BIP39 seed derivation (hardhat.config.js:410).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: BLAKE3 ships via @noble/hashes. Hash — Grover-only exposure. No application call site found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: scrypt KDF ships via scrypt-js (ethereumjs-wallet/hdkey dependency chain). Memory-hard KDF, not Shor-relevant. No application call site found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: SHA-3 ships via @noble/hashes. Distinct from the keccak256 used at hardhat.config.js:476 (Ethereum uses pre-standard Keccak-256, not NIST SHA3).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: XSalsa20-Poly1305 (tweetnacl secretbox) ships in the build. Symmetric AE — Grover-only exposure, not Shor-vulnerable. No application call site found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: self-signed X.509 certificate generation ships via the selfsigned package (node-forge based), pulled in by the hardhat toolbox chain. No application call site found in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: X.509 certificate parsing/issuance ships via node-forge in the build. No application call site found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: tweetnacl ships in the build — provides XSalsa20-Poly1305 AE, Ed25519 signatures and X25519 ECDH (the latter two Shor-vulnerable). No application call site found in this repo; reachable via runtime config or dependencies.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: scrypt-js ships via the ethereumjs-wallet/hdkey chain — the same chain the application uses for BIP32 HD wallets in hardhat.config.js.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: sha.js ships and is the runtime hash backend of the pbkdf2 shim used by bip39's mnemonicToSeed (the application call site is hardhat.config.js:410).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: elliptic ships and is the secp256k1 engine behind ethereumjs-wallet/hdkey — the application derives secp256k1 HD keys with it in hardhat.config.js:412-417. Shor-vulnerable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/hashes ships SHA-2/SHA-3/BLAKE2/BLAKE3 in the build. No application call site found in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: selfsigned ships in the build — generates self-signed X.509 certificates with RSA keys via node-forge. No application call site found in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: hash.js ships SHA-1/SHA-2/Keccak/RIPEMD in the build (ethereumjs-util chain). No application call site found in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: pbkdf2 (node shim) ships and is the KDF backend of bip39.mnemonicToSeed — the application call site is hardhat.config.js:410 (BIP39, HMAC-SHA512, 2048 iterations).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: node-forge ships RSA keygen/signing, X.509, TLS and AES in the build (via selfsigned/hardhat toolbox chain). No application call site found in this repo.
